items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: And then I would ask people, like say, “Doc, you remember that guy” and everybody would get hip

ctx.x: I don’t know. I’m just making it up. And then they’d say, “How much time you going to do?” And I always said, “Six minutes.” And they’d say, “You never do six minutes, you always go over.” I’d say, “Well this time I’m going to —” they never complained. And once in a while when they’d say to me, “Look we’re short of time that last segment ran really long with so-and-so actor or some politician or something. So we don’t have much time, do you want to just tell one joke or do you want to just go to the panel?” I…

And they didn’t know I was sitting back there. So they all turned around and they saw me and they say, “Hey, we didn’t know you were back there.” I said, “Well that’s okay, congratulations on your wedding and I wish you health and good luck.” They said, “Thank you.” And then the chick said, “Wait a minute, you’re that guy plays the piano with his nose.” I said, “Yeah, I’m afraid so.” The two of them left Ed and came back and talked to me. And he was just, I mean burning man. So that didn’t help at all. Because I…
